en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a Romanesque side entrance of a cathedral. The portal has an arched roof supported by columns, with sculpted lions at the base and additional animal statues on top of the canopy. The stone façade and cobblestone pavement are visible, and the border of the image has a scalloped edge typical of mid‑20th‑century postcards. At the bottom there is a printed caption in Italian.
